entities.summary: The Aksay post house is a complex of small buildings of historic posting station in Aksay, Rostov oblast, Russia. It consists of residential facilities and household building. Aksay post house is affiliate of the Aksay war-historical museum. The complex is considered to be an object of cultural heritage.
